svg.title: Yellow Curve
svg.desc: Interpretive study after an actually inspected primary reference. Geometry and interpretive screen colour approximate. Schematic silhouette in the actually photographed FLOOR PROJECTION; yellow panel only, no gallery floor/wall. This is not a reconstructed plan and cannot be compared at physical scale. interpretive yellow is interpretive. Palette refinement (2026-11-09): specific source-image review of yellow; interpretive screen colors, not calibrated to original paint.
svg.metadata: Primary reference: https://ellsworthkelly.org/work/yellow-curve/; catalogue record ek-808; inspected2026-10-27. Pure editable vector study, not photographic facsimile.
